subject: CloudCo-op accelerator — request for promotional escrow credits
messages:
From: Emily Gonzales <emily@cloudcoop.org>
To: logan.wright@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Promo credit request for CloudCo-op winter cohort

Hi Logan,

Hope you’re well — I’m Emily, Partnerships Lead at CloudCo-op Accelerator. We’re kicking off our winter cohort (starts Jan 10) and would like to route a promotional credit allocation to enable 20 startups to run 30-day trials on Redwood.

Request: $20,000 in partner credits (to be held in escrow / partner pool), redeemable by cohort teams for 90-day trials.
Why Redwood: performance and easy private deploys are a huge selling point for our enterprise-focused founders.

Attached is our partner intake form and a one-page program brief. Can you confirm Redwood’s intake/approval process, any required MOU language, and expected timeline? We can fast-track the cohort onboarding if we get approvals this week.

Attachments: cloudcoop_partner_intake.pdf (partner intake form), program_brief.pdf (one-pager)

Thanks — Emily
Emily Gonzales
Partnerships Lead | CloudCo-op Accelerator
emily@cloudcoop.org | +44 20 7946 0123
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Emily Gonzales <emily@cloudcoop.org>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ava_chen@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Promo credit request for CloudCo-op winter cohort

Hi Emily — great to meet you and thanks for the brief.

High-level okay from my side. Quick next steps so we can scope and move to approval:
- Kar, can you confirm allowable promo amount vs typical cohort size?
- Ava, can you prepare the standard partner escrow flow and templated MOU (we usually require DocuSign counter-sign before credits release).
- Emily, can you confirm whether credits should be restricted to hosted API only or include Private/Dedicated options? Also please share sponsor contact who will sign the MOU.

If we can get the intake + sponsor by EOD tomorrow, I’ll route to finance/legal for an expedited approval path.

Cheers,
Logan
Logan Wright
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: ava_chen@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2027 08:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Promo credit request for CloudCo-op winter cohort

Logan / Ava — I reviewed the intake. $20k total is fine for a cohort pilot if we gate redemptions to hosted API and cap per-team usage at $1,000. Conditions:
- Credits expire 90 days after activation.
- No Dedicated or Private consumption without explicit contract (we can allow Private after a technical/Procurement checklist).
- Require MOU + sponsor signature before releasing to escrow.

I’ve attached a provisional credit memo for Finance to reference. If legal needs to tweak MOU language I’ll standby.

Attachment: provisional-credit-memo.pdf

-Karthik
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: finance@redwood.com, legal@redwood.com
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, emily@cloudcoop.org
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 13:11:00 -0800
Subject: CloudCo-op — MOU & escrow routing (requesting legal/finance review)

Hi Finance / Legal —

Following discussions with CloudCo-op, requesting review + signoff to route $20k into partner escrow for the winter cohort. Summary:
- Amount: $20,000 (redeemable by up to 20 startups; capped at $1,000 per team).
- Allowed product: Hosted API only; Private/Dedicated requires contract amendment.
- Expiry: credits expire 90 days from activation by each team.
- Release: Finance to fund escrow upon signed MOU (DocuSign link below).

Please review the attached provisional cred memo and MOU draft. If approved, mark for expedited processing (CloudCo-op’s cohort kickoff is Jan 10).

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/00A1B2C3D4E5F6G7
Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/partners/cloudcoop-intake
Attachments: provisional-credit-memo.pdf, cloudcoop_mou_draft.pdf

Thanks — Ava
Ava Chen
Partner Operations | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com
From: Emily Gonzales <emily@cloudcoop.org>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, ava_chen@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 5 Dec 2027 17:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Promo credit request for CloudCo-op winter cohort

Hi Logan / Ava —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. I signed the MOU via DocuSign (file attached) and confirmed the sponsor (CloudCo-op Foundation). We accept the Hosted-only restriction and per-team cap. Please let us know when the escrow is funded so we can publish onboarding instructions to the cohort.

Attachment: cloudcoop_signed_mou.pdf

Looking forward to partnering —
Emily
Emily Gonzales
Partnerships Lead | CloudCo-op Accelerator
emily@cloudcoop.org
